original_text: The employer shall establish a rescue station close to the workplace, equipped with the necessary rescue and first-aid equipment.

description: The station shall have suitable means of communication enabling immediate assistance to be requested, and the employer shall appoint a trained technical worker to supervise rescue and first-aid operations.
applicability: Applicable to all mines and quarries
original_text: The station shall have suitable means of communication enabling immediate assistance to be requested, and the employer shall appoint a trained technical worker to supervise rescue and first-aid operations.

description: Where individual mines or quarries employ fewer than fifty workers and are located within a twenty-kilometer-diameter area, the employers may jointly establish a centrally located rescue and first-aid facility, or an employer may establish an independent rescue and first-aid facility.
applicability: Applicable to all mines and quarries
original_text: Where individual mines or quarries employ fewer than fifty workers and are located within a twenty-kilometer-diameter area, the employers may jointly establish a centrally located rescue and first-aid facility, or an employer may establish an independent rescue and first-aid facility.

rule_name: Determination of Rescue and First-Aid Equipment and Preventive and Protective Measures
description: The Minister may determine the rescue and first-aid equipment and the preventive and protective measures required in mines and quarries.
original_text: The Minister may determine the rescue and first-aid equipment and the preventive and protective measures required in mines and quarries, as well as the responsibilities of employers and the rights and duties of workers.

rule_name: Labor inspection carried out by Ministry employees or designated Saudi nationals
description: Labor inspection shall be carried out by inspectors who are employees of the Ministry, or by other Saudi nationals designated by the Minister or the Minister's delegate. Such inspectors shall have the powers and jurisdiction prescribed by this Law.
applicability: Applicable to all labor inspections conducted by inspectors as per the Law.
original_text: Labor inspection shall be carried out by inspectors who are employees of the Ministry, or by other Saudi nationals designated by the Minister or the Minister's delegate. Such inspectors shall have the powers and jurisdiction prescribed by this Law.

rule_name: Labor inspectors responsible for monitoring implementation and providing guidance
description: Labor inspectors shall be responsible for the following: 1. Monitoring implementation of this Law, its Implementing Regulations, and the decisions issued for its implementation. 2. Providing employers and workers with technical information and guidance enabling them to follow the best means of implementing this Law.
applicability: Applicable to all labor inspectors as per the Law.
original_text: Labor inspectors shall be responsible for the following: 1. Monitoring implementation of this Law, its Implementing Regulations, and the decisions issued for its implementation. 2. Providing employers and workers with technical information and guidance enabling them to follow the best means of implementing this Law.

rule_name: Labor inspectors have the right to enter establishments without prior notice
description: Labor inspectors shall have the right to: 1. Enter any establishment subject to the Labor Law at any time during the establishment's working hours without prior notice.
applicability: Applicable to all labor inspections conducted by inspectors as per the Law.
original_text: Labor inspectors shall have the right to: 1. Enter any establishment subject to the Labor Law at any time during the establishment's working hours without prior notice.

description: A person conducting an inspection shall notify the employer or the employer's representative of the inspector's presence, unless the inspector considers that the purpose of the inspection requires otherwise.
original_text: A person conducting an inspection shall notify the employer or the employer's representative of the inspector's presence, unless the inspector considers that the purpose of the inspection requires otherwise.

description: A labor inspector may issue instructions requiring employers to make, within periods specified by the inspector, modifications to work arrangements, devices, and equipment in order to ensure compliance with provisions concerning workers' health and safety.
original_text: A labor inspector may issue instructions requiring employers to make, within periods specified by the inspector, modifications to work arrangements, devices, and equipment in order to ensure compliance with provisions concerning workers' health and safety.

description: A labor inspector shall keep absolutely confidential any complaint received concerning a defect in equipment or a violation of the provisions of the Law and shall not disclose to the employer or the employer's representative the existence of such complaint.
original_text: A labor inspector shall keep absolutely confidential any complaint received concerning a defect in equipment or a violation of the provisions of the Law and shall not disclose to the employer or the employer's representative the existence of such complaint.

description: Whenever necessary, physicians, engineers, chemists, and occupational safety and health specialists shall participate in inspections. The Director of the Labor Office and labor inspectors may, where necessary, request the competent executive authorities to provide the assistance required.
original_text: Whenever necessary, physicians, engineers, chemists, and occupational safety and health specialists shall participate in inspections. description: The Minister shall issue the Implementing Regulations governing and organizing inspection activities.
original_text: The Minister shall issue the Implementing Regulations governing and organizing inspection activities.

rule_name: Financial Reward for Assisting in Detecting Violations
description: The Minister may grant a financial reward not exceeding 25% of the amount of the fine collected to any person, whether an inspection employee or another person, who assists in detecting a violation of this Law, its Implementing Regulations, or the decisions issued for its implementation.
applicability: Applicable to any person who assists in detecting a violation of the Law, its Implementing Regulations, or the decisions issued for its implementation.
original_text: The Minister may grant a financial reward not exceeding 25% of the amount of the fine collected to any person, whether an inspection employee or another person, who assists in detecting a violation of this Law, its Implementing Regulations, or the decisions issued for its implementation.

rule_name: Admissibility of Labor Claims After 12 Months
description: A claim before the labor courts seeking a right provided for under this Law or arising from an employment contract shall be admissible after twelve months have elapsed from the date on which the employment relationship ended, unless the claimant presents an excuse accepted by the court or the defendant acknowledges the right.
applicability: Applicable to claims seeking a right provided for under the Law or arising from an employment contract after 12 months have elapsed from the date on which the employment relationship ended.
original_text: A claim before the labor courts seeking a right provided for under this Law or arising from an employment contract shall be admissible after twelve months have elapsed from the date on which the employment relationship ended, unless the claimant presents an excuse accepted by the court or the defendant acknowledges the right.

rule_name: Employer's Obligation to Maintain Employment Conditions
description: While a case is pending before the labor courts, the employer may not alter the employment conditions that were in force before the proceedings commenced in a manner that would prejudice the worker's position in the case.
applicability: Applicable to the employer while a case is pending before the labor courts.
original_text: While a case is pending before the labor courts, the employer may not alter the employment conditions that were in force before the proceedings commenced in a manner that would prejudice the worker's position in the case.

description: The Minister shall issue the decisions and regulations necessary to implement the provisions of this Law within one hundred and eighty days from the date on which this Law enters into force.
original_text: The Minister shall issue the decisions and regulations necessary to implement the provisions of this Law within one hundred and eighty days from the date on which this Law enters into force. The Implementing Regulations shall be published in the Official Gazette.
